rationale_summary: On frozen Train+Dev (651 core answerable / 115 core negative; Dev 122 / 38) under V0.1.7 signed gates (Recall@100/200, Hit@1/3, MRR, negative rejection, wrong proposed binding, per-domain floors, and 5 resource budgets with frozen ranking weights), NO experimental M0/M1/M2 toggle combination passes all gates simultaneously: (1) Recall-expanding configs (M0, M1, M0+M1, A1, A2, A4, A5, C1, C2) substantially raise Candidate Recall (+17 to +186), but under frozen V0.1.7 scoring weights every one degrades Hit@1 (-5 to -23), Hit@3 (-3 to -19), and MRR@10, and M1_KW / M0M1_KW / A4 / A5 / C1 / C2 also exceed signed P50 latency or working-set (M0M1_KW 770.61 > 768 MiB) ceilings; (2) A3 passes all 5 resource budgets (P50 58.9 ms, P95 176.4 ms) but suffers net Recall@200 regression of -9 (573->564, all 9 in 强电 where RRF+cap=200 evicts single-channel model_match/fts hits) plus Hit@3 -4 and MRR@10 drop; (3) Canonical text (A6/A7) and Keyword RRF (KW) remain disabled per M2 ruling. Therefore, all experimental recall switches remain default OFF (M0=0, M1=0, M2=0) as the sole frozen submission path, with two bounded safety/resource guards landed: OBS-COORD-M2-02 (skip M2 RRF/cap when semantic recall produces zero hits) and OBS-A-M1-01 (bound _fts_raw_rows LRU cache to 512). High-recall experimental configs (M1/C2) remain available behind explicit OFF-by-default toggles for joint ranking+recall evaluation in V0.1.9 upon coordinator approval.
